Name: PC's Victorian Furniture
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[line]
[center][img]http://i.imgur.com/JLmXZFF.png[/img][/center]
[line]
Victorian themed furniture pack to bring a little old-world elegance to your Stardew Valley home. Featuring many furniture pieces with ornate carvings, gilded accents, soft velvet cushions, and naturally - plenty of flowers!
[line]
[center][img]http://i.imgur.com/uTmDKcK.png[/img][/center]
[*] Requires [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Cacifire[/url] mod.
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url] are not required, but I do recommend them.
[*]The mod contains 2 catalogues: one for Hazelwood (Hazelwood Desk Cabinets) and one for Rosewood (Victorian Study). Both can be found at Robin's for 50,000g each.
[*]Both the Hazelwood and Rosewood sets have their proper brown recolors.
[*]More sets are planned in future update! (Including Sholmes Suite).


[center][img]http://i.imgur.com/QcWcM58.png[/img][/center]
[*]The wingback armchair that faces 3/4 and the back-facing version are not fully functional as chairs due to their height, which doesn't play nicely with vanilla armchair logic. Actually, the back-facing ones aren't even functional at all...
[*]Catalogue items are obtainable inside their Happy Home Designer menu, for decorating convinience purpose.

[center][img]http://i.imgur.com/vFe5484.png[/img][/center]
I use the term "Victorian" quite loosely here. Mostly they are something that I interpreted as Victorian era furniture, but they won't be 100% accurate.

[center][img]http://i.imgur.com/dqrY02A.png[/img][/center]
This mod has been on and off in development for about two years, and I'm elated that it finally out in the world! I want to express my gratitude to everyone who supported me with their kindness along the way. Thank you! <3

If you like this mod, don't forget to endorse! That way more people will see it and it'll make me happy.
